question: Which datasets are used for evaluation?

evidence: Apart from term frequency methods, question classification methods developed on one dataset generally do not exhibit strong transfer performance to other datasets BIBREF3 . While BERT-QC achieves large gains over existing methods on the ARC dataset, here we demonstrate that BERT-QC also matches state-of-the-art performance on TREC BIBREF6 , while surpassing state-of-the-art performance on the GARD corpus of consumer health questions BIBREF3 and MLBioMedLAT corpus of biomedical questions BIBREF4 . As such, BERT-QC is the first model to achieve strong performance across more than one question classification dataset.

title: Multi-class Hierarchical Question Classification for Multiple Choice Science Exams
answer_short: ARC (training, development, testing), TREC consumer health, and biomedical domain questions
answer_rationale: The evaluation datasets include ARC questions evaluated using the standard 3,370 training, 869 development, and 3,548 testing questions, as well as TREC consumer health questions and biomedical domain questions, as confirmed by the retrieved documents.
